summary_points: Document for quality assurance of a Molten Salt Pump.
Includes certificates for material and workmanship compliance.
Documents inspection and testing procedures.
Contains additional documents like material certificates and photos.
Liquid Penetrant Test Certificate for welding parts of the pump.
Pressure Test Certificate for pressure-loaded parts of the pump.
Balancing Certificate for the impeller of the pump.
Quality documentation for Rheinhuette Pumps LLC
Dimensional and visual check certificate issued on 27.09.2018
Painting certificate guaranteeing RHEINHÜTTE specification with total paint thickness ≥ 375 µm
Additional documents include inspection plans, procedures, test records, and material certificates
Performance test procedure according to ISO 9906 for hydraulic and mechanical testing
Sound pressure level tests are conducted on centrifugal pumps using a calibrated test motor.
Measurements are taken at a distance of 1 meter from the pump.
Records and reports must be kept for at least 10 years.
All instruments must provide accurate measurements.
Bearing temperature test procedure for centrifugal pumps.
Running test procedure including capacity, suction head, discharge head, speed, and power measurements.
Impeller balancing according to DIN ISO 1940 T1 on a rotational-balancing-machine.
Liquid visible penetrant examination (PT) according to ASME Sec. V, Article 6.
The procedure is for liquid visible penetrant examination on components.
It covers personnel qualification, safety requirements, and penetrant systems.
Visible penetrant (color contrast) will be used for inspection.
Procedure for Liquid Visible Penetrant Examination (PT) as per ASME Sec. V, Article 6.
Test devices include UV-meter, light meter, reference blocks acc. ISO 3452-3, and certificates acc. EN 10204-3.1.
Surface preparation involves cleaning with solvent-based cleaner and drying before applying penetrant.
Penetrant applied by spraying or brushing; dwell time ranges from 10 to 30 minutes.
Developer forms a thin white coating, and surface discontinuities indicated by bleed-out of penetrant.
Evaluation of indications during developer dwell time with conditions of Sec. 8.3.
Test results documented on part papers or separate test report acc. EN 10204-3.1.
Dimension checking involves measuring main and connection dimensions using calibrated instruments.
Final inspection includes visual examination, completeness check, functional check, and packing.
Paint coat application procedure for Rheinhuette Pumpen GmbH's pumps.
Product data includes paint system, method, and top coat details.
Surface preparation involves abrasive blasting and specific temperature and humidity conditions.
Layer thicknesses for first, intermediate, and top coats are provided.
Temperature range for operation and application is specified.
Defects must be repaired before applying further coats.
Test report includes efficiency test results with various parameters.
Performance curve shows relationship between flow rate, head, power consumption, and efficiency.
